description: The proxy puts the game window on the virtual display and never on a real monitor (fails closed), at 1080p, 1440p and 4K once the VDD modes from J2's open question 1 exist; window position kept out of the preferences file (profiles restore it byte for byte); measured over a whole launch. Port the design of Empire's headless.cpp and display guard, not its size.
title: Headless runs on the virtual display
